name: 二楠之盾
prompt:
Use case: compositing / ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished, production-feasible visual effect concept board for the existing portrait Chinese village-defense mobile game 代代守村. The new skill exact name is "二楠之盾". This is a design proposal, not a screenshot of implemented code.
Input image 1 is the ACTUAL current game screenshot: preserve its scene art, camera, village, road, trees, villagers, towers, HUD, golden circular skill button, proportions and readability. Input image 2 is the exact current wooden orange-thatch gate asset: use this gate design consistently in every close-up, don't redesign the building.
Make a landscape approximately 1536x1024 presentation board in the game's refined warm cream parchment, green header accents, fine golden border style. Crisp Chinese typography with generous spacing, absolutely no pixel art. Header "二楠之盾", smaller subtitle "城门短时无敌 · 青蓝守护". Footer label "效果设计稿 · 非实机截图".
Layout: LEFT about 36% of board: a full tall phone gameplay view based closely on image1, scene fully visible and unchanged EXCEPT this gate defensive skill is active. No red tower effects. At the gate ONLY, show a prominent yet compact cyan-blue translucent arched dome hugging the gate roof and feet, bright pearl-white inner rim, saturated turquoise outer rim, sparse delicate warm-gold accents. Keep the actual orange gate architecture visible through a very subtle transparent fill. A soft thin elliptical rim sits on the ground at the gate feet. Do not cover the road, tower labels, health numbers, Civilization village sign, neighboring buildings or villagers. The gate health text remains "200/200", and the slim existing bar is cyan to indicate protection; a tiny shield badge beside that gauge. No extra stacked status labels around the crowded gate. The shield outline must be obvious at phone scale without bloom washing out the image. Existing top green status strip reads "二楠之盾 · 城门无敌". The circular bottom button keeps its golden background but uses a polished turquoise enamel shield icon with warm gold rim and a miniature wood-gate motif, name "二楠之盾", small note "保护中". Pause and speed buttons remain as in screenshot.
RIGHT about 64%: THREE clear enlarged sequential gate close-ups in generous equal columns/sections with thin gold separators and small connecting arrows. Consistent unchanged gate geometry, lighting, view and ground.
1: title "发动"; show a bright cyan arc rapidly opening from the gate base into the dome, a single clean shield crest briefly lights at the center. Caption "护盾展开".
2: title "保护中"; show stable fully formed cyan translucent dome and a small local circular ripple at the front surface where one existing-game-style bandit reaches the gate. Gate clearly readable inside; no blood, no explosion, no lightning, no damage to gate, no enemy bouncing backward, no enemy pileup. Caption "触门免伤".
3: title "自然结束"; show the same gate with dome rim thinning and softly contracting/fading into a small outline near its base. Gate unchanged, no cracks or shattered fragments, no particles. Caption "光罩渐隐".
Below the three close-ups include a tasteful compact row showing the standalone skill shield icon and the two short accurate notes "无敌期间不扣城门耐久" and "只保护城门，不回血". A tiny note "结算时立即收起" may be used below the natural-ending panel.
Visual priorities: cyan shield must stand out vividly against green grass and orange wooden gate while retaining clean high-definition 3D-pre-rendered-2D game look. Broad readable shapes, realistic resource economy: a few reusable 2D sprites, transparency, scale and simple wave rings; NOT hundreds of sparks or ornate magical writing or full-screen dramatic film effects. No particles, no full-screen tint, no giant shield covering half the map, no new giant gate, no humanoid guardian, no 3D gameplay camera change, no unapproved purchase cost or duration numbers. Keep accurate skill name "二楠之盾" throughout. The full-game view and close-ups must visibly depict the SAME implementable cyan dome design.
